caseName: Neal v. American Telephone & Telegraph Co.
caseNameFull: Neal v. American Telephone & Telegraph Co. and Neal v. City of Huntsville

opinions.text:
Appeals from Sup. Ct. Ala. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases. †
